items.stem: Which of the following is a criterion for congruence of triangles?

In the given figure, if two triangles have two pairs of corresponding angles equal and one pair of corresponding sides equal, which congruence test can be used to prove that the triangles are congruent?
In the given figure, congruent sides of quadrilateral ABCD are shown by identical marks. Which test is used to prove that triangles ABD and CBD are congruent?
In triangle ABC and triangle DEF, if AB = DE, BC = EF, and ∠A = ∠D, can we say that the triangles are congruent?
In the given figure, if AB is congruent to CD, BC is congruent to DA, and ∠ABC is congruent to ∠CDA, which test proves that triangles ABC and CDA are congruent?
In the given figure, if sides AB and CB are congruent to sides DE and FE respectively, and angle ABC is congruent to angle DEF, which test proves that triangles ABC and DEF are congruent?
What is the name of the test that states that if two angles of a triangle and a side included by them are congruent with the corresponding parts of another triangle, then the triangles are congruent?
In a figure, two triangles are shown with two congruent sides and a non-included angle. What can be said about the congruence of these triangles?
In a triangle, two sides and an angle not included by them are congruent with the corresponding parts of another triangle. What can be concluded about the congruence of the triangles?
In the given figure, parts of the triangles with identical marks are congruent. Which test of congruence can be used to prove the triangles are congruent?

In the given figure, if ∠A = ∠P, ∠B = ∠Q, and AB = PQ, which congruence test can be used to prove that the triangles are congruent?
In a triangle, if two sides and the included angle are congruent to two sides and the included angle of another triangle, which test is used to prove congruence?
Which test is used to determine the congruence of two right-angled triangles when their hypotenuse and one side are congruent?
In a triangle, two sides and the included angle are congruent with the corresponding parts of another triangle. Which test can be used to prove the congruence of the triangles, and why?
What is the term used to describe two triangles that have exactly the same shape and size?
If two triangles are congruent, which of the following is true?
Which of the following is a test for congruence of triangles?
If two triangles are congruent, what can be said about their corresponding angles?
In the given figure, if AB = PQ, BC = QR, and AC = PR, which congruence test can be used to prove that the triangles are congruent?
In a right-angled triangle, if the hypotenuse and one side are congruent to the hypotenuse and one side of another right-angled triangle, which test is used to prove congruence?
In a figure, two triangles have their corresponding sides marked as congruent. What is the test and the correspondence of vertices that can be used to prove their congruence?
